2607.14967.title: Latent Trajectory Discrimination for AI-Generated Text Detection
2607.14967.paper_summary: Most existing approaches to AI-Generated Text Detection (AIGTD) treat documents as static objects and base their decisions on aggregate statistics or globally compressed embeddings. However, this perspective overlooks the inherently dynamic nature of autoregressive generation, where content evolves progressively through the latent space. In this paper, we reformulate AIGTD as the problem of distinguishing between latent generation trajectories. Instead of relying on static representations, we model how textual representations evolve across the sequence. To this end, we propose Geometric Trajectory and Contrastive Learning (GTCL), a framework that segments the document into ordered local units, encodes each unit in an embedding space, and constructs a structured and sequence-level representation. GTCL then applies contrastive learning to these trajectories to learn geometric regularities associated with the autoregressive generation. Evaluations performed on three different benchmarks and several approaches show that GTCL outperforms detection baselines consistently, which implies that explicitly modeling sequential dynamics provides robust discriminative signals across models and domains. These results suggest that modeling trajectory differences could improve detection and open up a dynamic direction that has been underexplored in previous AIGTD literature.
2607.14967.paper_summary_zh: 大多數現有的人工智慧生成文本檢測（AIGTD）方法將文件視為靜態對象，並基於聚合統計或全局壓縮嵌入來做出決策。<lb/>然而，這種觀點忽略了自回歸生成的固有動態特性，其中內容通過潛在空間逐步演變。<lb/>在本文中，我們將AIGTD重新表述為區分潛在生成軌跡的問題。<lb/>我們不再依賴靜態表示，而是建模文本表示如何在序列中演變。<lb/>為此，我們提出了幾何軌跡與對比學習（GTCL），這是一個將文檔劃分為有序局部單元的框架，將每個單元編碼到嵌入空間中，並構建結構化和序列級別的表示。<lb/>然後，GTCL對這些軌跡應用對比學習，以學習與自回歸生成相關的幾何規律。<lb/>在三個不同基準和幾種方法上進行的評估顯示，GTCL始終優於檢測基線，這意味著明確建模序列動態提供了跨模型和領域的穩健區分信號。<lb/>這些結果表明，建模軌跡差異可以改善檢測，並開啟一個在先前AIGTD文獻中未被充分探索的動態方向。
